name: pt-gordon
goal: photo_tools (image_convert) wave 1: Gordon authors kmeans.rs (M), smooth.rs (M). First Rust campaigns: measure which scope suits each member. S small, M exact/byte-exact, L largest algorithm, C crate-facing with the API card.

tasks.instructions: No randomness. Bins in ascending key order; farthest-first initial centres with the stated tie-breaks; stop when an assignment repeats; f64 for positions and centres; labels from the ROUNDED palette in integers. Walk every table row. Write the module once, in one reply; do not restate the contract.
tasks.test_instructions: Use the worked examples; include max_iter 0 (11.5 rounds to 12), k 0, k above the number of bins, and both tie rules.

tasks.instructions: Write the arithmetic exactly as the contract shows - the two sides of a shared border must agree bit for bit. Distances strictly greater than epsilon are kept; ties go to the smallest index. Closed loops wrap the Catmull-Rom neighbours; chains between junctions clamp them. Write the module once, in one reply; do not restate the contract.
tasks.test_instructions: Cover simplify's rules, both canonical directions, split_chains with 0, 1 and several junctions, epsilon 0 versus Catmull-Rom, and that walking a loop backwards gives the same segments reversed.
